events.title: v4.0.0 Charter and topic pages
events.detail: The charter and semantic topic pages replace the former root monolith. A task-oriented reading map comes with a short human entry and a bounded Agent entry.

events.title: v4.1.0 MIT license
events.detail: Repository source and its documentation adopt the MIT license. The English topic pages regain evidence contrasts, diagnostic and solution criteria, Agent stop and scope checks and accountable management boundaries.

events.title: v5.0.0 Monthly and quarterly reviews return
events.detail: Monthly review of real work and weak signals returns, with a quarterly review of whether rules and tools earn their cost. No mandatory weekly meeting or new reporting form comes with them. Verification now requires Node 26 and npm 11.

events.title: v5.0.3 An example decision path
events.detail: Members and Agents get one market-history decision path as an example, from point-in-time research through production and permitted use. Task lead, decision owner, reviewer and acceptor roles are clarified.

events.title: v5.1.0 Release order and live links
events.detail: The signed dual-Forge release order is documented, and live link qualification with pinned lychee runs after the tag. Guidance pages on GitLab and GitHub show their title first.

events.title: v7.0.0 Vale checks the prose
events.detail: Spelling, repeated-word, concise-expression and terminology checks move into native Vale. The textlint, CSpell and write-good pipelines are removed.

events.title: v7.0.1 Duties lost in compression return
events.detail: Decision constraints, execution costs and milestones, professional data judgments and delivery priorities lost during compression are restored. Data ownership appears in a compact responsibility table.

events.title: v7.0.4 Sample bias and missing context
events.detail: Historical analysis checks sample-selection bias and explains how missingness, delay, conflict and anomalies affect conclusions. Agents continue on stated assumptions when missing context is not blocking.

events.title: v7.0.6 History on both Forges
events.detail: Every Changelog section offers labeled GitLab and GitHub history. One unchanged source serves both platforms and offline readers.

events.title: v7.0.12 Read complete results first
events.detail: Agents read complete, current, claim-matched verification results before they summarize. Analytical conclusions name their next verification action.

events.title: v8.0.0 New routes and review defaults
events.detail: The task map is organized around direction, data, delivery and collaboration. Minimum monthly and quarterly review frequencies become defaults the responsible owner may adjust for a recorded reason. Installed ETHOS runs every remaining check.
